created_prompt: Create a concrete three-year plan for Julie to grow her online cooking video business. The plan needs to prioritize growing her online presence and follower count, and include milestones for publishing a cookbook, including time to explore what the best publishing option for that is. Her constraints are a 4 day work week (32 hours per week) and a limited budget, ie, any monetary outlay in the plan should be balanced by an expectation of increased income.
